apikey.description: Will use the `PINECONE_API_KEY` environment variable if not set.

environment.description: Will use the `PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT` environment variable if not set.

dimension.description: The dimensions of the vectors to be inserted in the index

metric.description: The distance metric to be used for similarity search. You can use 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'dotproduct'.

name.description: The name of the index to be created. The maximum length is 45 characters.

pods.description: The number of pods for the index to use,including replicas.

replicas.description: The number of replicas. Replicas duplicate your index. They provide higher availability and throughput.

source_collection.description: The name of the collection to create an index from
